game: Mega Man Battle Network 5: Team Colonel (USA)
about: Addresses, names and descriptions only: facts about the ROM, read from Cyberworld Endless's own sources (src/emu/*.h, src/core/rom.c, docs/ROM_DATA.md). No graphics, text, sound or code of the game. See docs/SYMBOLS.md.

56.title: Another game's maps
56.how: Verify: with the ROM beside BN6's, `--atlas DIR:x0` draws its maps, ACDC Town at 0x00:0, Lan's room at 0x01:0, the harbour at 0x03:0 and the internet's from 0x80:0, with their walls, floor heights and triggers counted.

57.title: Another game's songs
57.how: Verify: `--net-biome x0` with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xsong: song 0x13 ... in slot 0x26" and the music player's song in that space ("music t60 song 089cef4c"); its sound dumped (`CYBERWORLD_AUDIO_DUMP`) does not correlate with BN6's net theme on a Central layer (`--net-biome 0 --seed 2`).

58.title: Another game's Navis
58.how: Verify: `--net-biome x0` with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xnavi: navi 60 ... at 72" and "xnavi: navi 62 ... at 74"; a bystander there stands and turns in the HeelNavi's shape and speaks with its face, and at `--seed 1 --run-depth 2` "bystander 0: list 6 74 at 52 -116" is the orange Navi, who speaks with its own face (`--talk npc`).

59.title: BN5 guest battles
59.how: Verify: in `tools/romlab` with BN5's ROM, a state in Lan's room (title, START, NEW GAME, A through the intro), the record `00 36 15 00 00 00 38 00 E2 49 00 00` with an entity list `00 22 00 00 11 25 01 00 F0` and the patch: the next frame is a battle with a Mettaur (enemy id 1, 40 HP); in the game, a BN5 layer whose area names its records (`xbattles`) fights BN5's own formations (group 0x80 map 0: Champy and Mettaur on a yellow field).

60.title: BN5's results screen, its second reward and BugFrags
60.how: Verify: `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=1 CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 tools/play.py start NAME --seed 1 -- --scene emu --net-biome x0 --dev quiet,gem,onehit` (`gem`: a Mystery Data of row 0 in every guest battle), then `battle; wait 1000` and `wait 270`: the Mystery Data says GET!, the screen shows "200 z" then "BugFrag 1", the log "its results screen gave 40C8 and C001", and the state after it `zenny 200` and `bugfrags 1` (the build before, with the switch alone: `bugfrags 0`); seed 4 without `onehit`, the autopilot breaks it and the second word is 0000; with no switch, Oran Area's record `0x0812153C` (byte 2 0x17; `--net-biome x4 --seed 1 --dev quiet,onehit`) finds Tornado L, in \* with All \* (`--setup endless,0,0,8`).

61.title: BN5's random numbers
61.how: Verify in the game, with BN5 beside BN6: `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 build.py shot --scene emu --net-biome x0 --seed S --dev quiet` with the arrival's words paged and `0:battle` (the layer's first random battle) prints "guest: its random numbers from seed ..." (seed 1: `85EBCA77`, words `9BB31115` and `DCB010DD`); seed 1's first Custom screen offers Vulcan1 D, seed 2's Recov10 A, seed 3's and seed 4's a Cannon A in other hands; seed 1 run again, or with RIGHT held as the battle comes, gives the same picture.

62.title: BN5's battle for the autopilot and the dev switches
62.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=1 CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 build.py shot --scene emu --run-depth 1 --net-biome x0 --seed 1 --frames 6000` wins its guest battle at 100 HP (Cannon on the Mettaur, the buster on the Powie; where the button pattern the autopilot pressed before was deleted), and the battle step with `--dev quiet,onehit` shows its viruses at 1 HP on the first Custom screen.

63.title: BN5 DarkChips
63.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, a guest battle with `--dev darkchips=0x3,worried` (`--talk guest:200`, by hand: use a chip in the first turn) offers DrkSword on the second Custom screen with the cursor on it; used, MegaMan turns dark, and after the battle `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "dark: a DarkChip used: max HP 100 -> 80" (a battle without one prints nothing); a capture with `--talk dark:430` on that layer prints "xnavi: list 7 0x68 of ... at list 7 160, 4012 bytes" and shows the purple flame and MegaMan's words.

66.title: The run's buster in BN5's battles
66.how: Verify in the game: an Attack+1 run (seed 6's layer-1 gift with `--run-depth 1 --net-biome x0`, placed and RUN in the NaviCust, STATUS then showing Attack LV 2) prints "guest: battle ..., buster Attack 2, Speed 1, Charge 1" and "guest: its battle's buster Attack 2, Speed 1, Charge 1" with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1`, and its first shot takes a Mettaur from 40 HP to 38.

67.title: BN5's Navis as guardians
67.how: Verified in romlab with BN5's ROM: KnightMan's V1 record forced from Lan's room (its GAME OVER bit cleared, the guest's way) ran his battle, KnightMan at 600 HP on panel (6,2) (his battle object `0x0203B2D8`, +0x24 the HP); his V1 stats row written `0x01C2` first spawned him at 450 of 450; with options `0x02` added a won battle showed the results screen with his row's KnightMn K (`0x14FE`), none without; Colonel's V2 (0x03) and the V3s run as battles of their own.

68.title: BN5's Souls
68.how: Verified in romlab from Lan's room after the intro, a folder of AirHoc Q (Break) owned: with KnightMan's flag 0x000C alone no UNITE stood; with flag 0x0000 too UNITE stood grey under OK, lit with an AirHoc picked, and UNITE then OK united MegaMan with KnightMan's Soul; with flag 0x0236 and DarkDril D picked, Chaos Unison, its charged shot the DarkDril's drill.

69.title: BN5 map objects
69.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 build.py shot --scene emu --net-biome x0 --run-depth 2 --dev pieces=16 --seed 6` prints "xnavi: list 7 0x1 of ... at list 7 146, 4335 bytes" and "blockers: lock 0, kind 5, variant 9, at world 120,108"; a capture with MegaMan put down at 70 100 shows the green cube in a walkway's mouth, and with flag 0x1465 set (`0:flags 0x1465 0x1465 1`) A at it enters the P-Code: it opens its eyes and flickers out.

88.title: Net maps' backdrops and animations
88.how: Verify: in romlab, warped into each BN5 map, its BG palette (`0x05000000`, dumped every 32 frames) changes in those banks and no others; with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xbackdrop: ... map 0x90:0's backdrop and animations for 0x90:0" (0x93:0 for 0x91:1, 0x94:3 for 0x92:0), a capture of `--net-biome x0`, `x2` or `x3` over a few hundred frames shows BN5's backdrop moving and the GFXAnim slots at `0x020094C0` naming the copies, and BN6's own areas (`--seed 11` dresses none) draw frame for frame as without BN5.

109.title: The ROMs screen's faces
109.how: Verified by drawing BN5's list 8 as a sheet, each index labelled (0x45 and 0x5B Colonel, the empty black boxes at 0x07-0x0A, 0x2A, 0x2C, 0x40-0x44 and 0x51-0x55), and by `--scene launcher` with both ROMs: the BN5 cartridge shows Colonel, the BN6 one MegaMan.

116.title: The All * helper
116.how: Verify: with All *, three Cannon * staged as a first hand's first picks show "PrgAdvance" and GigaCan1 (with `0x2A01` left there, three Cannons fire one by one); the gift's TimeBom2 (codes C D E) reads TimeBom2 * in the PET's pack, and a folder's Sword moved to the pack and back reads Sword * there and in the folder.
